headline: Eagles Trade Cam Jurgens To Ravens
summary: The Eagles shockingly lost future Hall of Fame right tackle Lane Johnson to retirement on Tuesday. A day later, another of the Eagles’ offensive line stalwarts is exiting. headline: Texans HC DeMeco Ryans Reclaims Defensive Play-Calling Duties
summary: Sitting at 0-4, the Texans are not making a coaching change. A shift in responsibilities will be taking place along the sidelines, however. Head coach DeMeco Ryans announced on Wednesday that he is taking over defensive play-calling responsibilities.
